run_ccd_sphere_simulation: run the pybullet script that simulates spheres with continuous collision detection on a terrain mesh
create_collision_shape_mesh: create a collision shape from a terrain OBJ mesh file using GEOM_FORCE_CONCAVE_TRIMESH flags
create_multi_body_spheres: create multiple sphere bodies in a grid layout using createMultiBody with a sphere collision shape
change_dynamics_ccd: change body dynamics to set ccdSweptSphereRadius, spinningFriction, rollingFriction, and linearDamping
step_simulation_loop: step the pybullet physics simulation in a loop using stepSimulation while the client is connected
